text: Walk me through how you determined the scope boundary of the AI Management System and which AI systems are explicitly in or out.
intent: Establish that scope boundaries are documented, defensible, and enumerate AI systems.

followUps.text: How do you discover AI systems that bypass formal procurement (shadow AI)?

text: Show me the current scope statement document and when it was last reviewed.
intent: Verify document existence and review cadence.

text: How do you identify and document interested parties relevant to the AIMS, and what AI-specific concerns have they raised?
intent: Confirm interested-parties identification covers AI-specific stakeholders (data subjects, regulators, affected groups).

followUps.text: When was the most recent engagement with affected data subjects, and how were their concerns recorded?

text: Describe how the organisation's role in the AI value chain (provider, deployer, user, importer, distributor) was determined for each in-scope AI system.
intent: Verify role assignment per AI system, especially under EU AI Act overlap.

followUps.text: What contractual evidence binds the vendor to the AI obligations you are delegating?

text: How does top management demonstrate leadership and commitment to the AIMS, with examples from the last six months?
intent: Establish active, evidenced leadership rather than nominal sign-off.

followUps.text: Beyond the signature, what management decisions on AI risks are recorded in the last two management reviews?

text: Walk me through the AI policy: how it was approved, when it was last reviewed, and how it was communicated to staff.
intent: Verify policy lifecycle (existence, approval, review, communication).

followUps.text: Show me the page acknowledgement records for staff in AI-impacted roles.

text: Show me the AI roles and responsibilities matrix and how it maps to the AIMS RACI for each in-scope AI system.
intent: Verify clear ownership across AI lifecycle phases.

followUps.text: Who is the named accountable individual for safety incidents in this AI system?

text: Walk me through the AI risk assessment for one in-scope system end-to-end: identification, analysis, evaluation, treatment.
intent: Verify a complete risk-management workflow exists, not just a register.

followUps.text: When was this risk last re-evaluated, and what changed in the system or environment that triggered it?
How is version control and change history of the risk register preserved?

text: How is an AI System Impact Assessment (AISIA) triggered, and where is the most recent one for this system?
commonDeflections: we did the GDPR DPIA, that's enough

followUps.text: Where in the DPIA do you cover AI-specific harms (e.g., bias amplification, automation bias, hallucination consequences)?

text: Show me your AI objectives for this fiscal period, and how progress is measured.
intent: Verify SMART AI objectives with measurement.
commonDeflections: our objective is to use AI responsibly

followUps.text: What is the measurable indicator behind that objective and what is the current value?

text: How is competence determined for staff working on this AI system, and what records prove the competence is current?

followUps.text: Show me the most recent competence-assessment record for an ML engineer in this team.

text: What awareness training do staff outside the AI team receive about your AI policies and AI-specific risks?
intent: Verify Clause 7.3 awareness program reaches non-AI staff.
commonDeflections: only the AI team needs to know

followUps.text: How are customer-facing or support staff trained to recognise and route AI-related complaints?

text: Walk me through how documented information for this AIMS is controlled, including version, approval, and obsolete-document handling.

followUps.text: Show me the version history and approval audit trail for the AI policy.

text: Walk me through the operational planning and control for this AI system: how changes flow from request to production.
commonDeflections: the team just deploys when needed

followUps.text: Show me the change-management ticket and approval record for the most recent production deployment.
How are emergency changes documented, reviewed, and replayed against the AISIA?

text: How do you carry out AI risk treatment for this system, and where is the latest risk-treatment plan?

followUps.text: Who authorised acceptance of these residual risks, with what justification, and against which Annex A controls?

text: Walk me through the most recent AI System Impact Assessment for this system: scope, methodology, output, and approver.

followUps.text: If the system is already live, where is the AISIA that justified that go-live decision?

text: What metrics do you monitor for this AI system, who reviews them, and on what cadence?

followUps.text: Show me a recent monthly review where dashboard outputs led to a documented decision.

text: Show me the most recent internal audit of the AIMS: scope, findings, and follow-up.

followUps.text: Show me the AI-specific audit checklist used and the AI-specific findings raised.

text: Show me the latest management review minutes covering the AIMS: inputs, decisions, action items, owners, due dates.
commonDeflections: it's in our standing exec meeting

followUps.text: Pull up the agenda and minutes from that meeting where AIMS was specifically reviewed.

text: Walk me through how a non-conformity in this AI system flows from detection to corrective action to verified closure.

followUps.text: Show me a recent Jira ticket for an AI-specific NC, including root-cause analysis and effectiveness verification.

text: What evidence do you have of continual improvement of the AIMS over the last 12 months?

followUps.text: Point to a specific AIMS process change in the last year and the metric that improved as a result.

text: Show me the policies for AI system development and use, including the document tree and last review.
intent: Verify Annex A.2 (Policies related to AI).
commonDeflections: we just have one AI policy

followUps.text: Where are sub-policies for acceptable use, model lifecycle, and third-party AI procurement?

text: How is accountability assigned for AI outcomes — including harms — in this system?

followUps.text: Models cannot bear accountability. Who is the named human-accountable individual when this system causes harm?

text: Walk me through how computing, data, and tooling resources for this AI system are planned, allocated, and reviewed.

followUps.text: Show me the AI-specific resource plan that documents GPU/data/tool dependencies for this system.

text: What documented information exists for the data resources used by this system: provenance, quality, and licensing?

followUps.text: What data-licence and provenance attestation did the vendor provide, and how did you validate it?
How did you assess the legal basis and rights-clearance for scraped training data?

text: Walk me through the AISIA process from trigger to sign-off, and show me where it is integrated into project gating.
intent: Verify Annex A.5 AI System Impact Assessment integration.
commonDeflections: we do it once at the start

followUps.text: What triggers an AISIA refresh — model retraining, data drift, scope expansion, regulatory change?

text: Show me how affected individuals and societal harm potentials were identified in the most recent AISIA.

followUps.text: How does this system make automated or recommended decisions, and who downstream is affected by those?

text: Walk me through the AI system development lifecycle for this system, from problem definition through deployment.

followUps.text: Where is your MLOps lifecycle defined, and which control gates require AISIA or human sign-off?

text: Show me how training, validation, and test data were assembled for this model, including representativeness analysis.

followUps.text: What is the documented assessment of representativeness, bias, and gaps in this data?

text: Walk me through verification and validation activities for this model: methodology, acceptance criteria, results.

followUps.text: Show me the test plan, the documented acceptance criteria, and pass/fail evidence per criterion.
What red-team and adversarial-robustness tests were run, and what residual risks were accepted?

text: Walk me through the deployment process: pre-deployment checks, rollout, and rollback for this system.

followUps.text: What automated gates run before promotion to production, and what triggers an automatic rollback?

text: Walk me through the post-deployment operation and monitoring for this AI system.
intent: Verify Annex A.6.2.7/8 operation and decommissioning.

followUps.text: What is the threshold that defines 'wrong' here, and how is the system monitored against it?

text: Show me the data-management plan for this AI system, including roles, retention, and access controls.

followUps.text: Show me the AI-specific data-handling responsibilities formally assigned to that team for this system.

text: How is data quality assessed for this AI system, and what is the most recent quality report?
intent: Verify Annex A.7.4 quality of data.

followUps.text: Show me the documented data-quality metrics and the latest measurements for this system.

text: Show me how data provenance for training and operational inputs is tracked end-to-end.
commonDeflections: it comes from our data lake

followUps.text: Where is the data-lineage tooling that traces specific datasets back to their source systems?

text: How is personally identifiable information used by this AI system identified, minimised, and protected?

followUps.text: Show me the AI-specific PII inventory and the minimisation steps documented for this system.

text: What information is provided to users and affected parties about this AI system, and how is it kept current?
intent: Verify Annex A.8 information for interested parties.

followUps.text: Show me the AI-specific disclosures about model role, limitations, and human-oversight options.

text: Show me the registered concerns or complaints from external parties about this AI system in the last 12 months.

followUps.text: Where is the channel that receives such complaints, and what evidence shows it is reachable?

text: What communication is provided to users when this AI system makes or supports a decision that affects them?
intent: Verify Annex A.8.5 communication of incidents.

followUps.text: Show me the actual disclosure copy that the user sees and how it explains the AI's role.

text: How does this AI system support human oversight in operation, including override and intervention capabilities?

followUps.text: Walk me through the operator console, the override action, and the audit log entry it produces.

text: Show me the documented intended uses and prohibited uses of this AI system.

followUps.text: Where are the prohibited use cases (e.g., legal advice, medical diagnosis) explicitly listed and enforced?

text: What logging and audit trails capture the AI system's operation, decisions, and human interventions?

followUps.text: Show me a sample log entry for an AI decision and explain what each field captures and how long it is retained.

text: Show me the third-party AI components in this system and the agreements that govern them.

followUps.text: Which clauses of that agreement specifically address AI obligations, residual liability, and incident reporting?

text: How is responsibility allocated between you and your AI providers/customers across the AI value chain?

followUps.text: Where is that responsibility explicitly assigned in writing to the customer, and what evidence confirms acceptance?

text: Walk me through the prompt-injection defences for this LLM-based system.
intent: Verify defence-in-depth against OWASP LLM01 prompt injection.

followUps.text: Show me the input/output filters and the latest red-team results against prompt-injection attempts.

text: How is hallucination risk for user-facing outputs managed in this LLM system?

followUps.text: Show me the user-facing disclosure copy and the measured hallucination rate that disclosure is calibrated against.

text: Show me the system prompt(s) and how changes to them are reviewed and version-controlled.

followUps.text: Show me the diff and approval record for the most recent change to the system prompt.

text: Walk me through how documents are ingested, chunked, embedded, and indexed for this RAG system, including provenance tracking.

followUps.text: Show me the documented ingestion pipeline owned by your team, not the framework defaults.

text: How do you prevent injection of untrusted retrieved content from steering the model (indirect prompt injection)?
intent: Verify A.6.2.5 protections against indirect prompt injection via retrieval.

followUps.text: How is retrieved content sandboxed or signed before being injected into the model context?

text: Walk me through the agent's tool-use authorisation model: which tools, who approved, and how scope is enforced.

followUps.text: Show me the sandbox configuration and the most recent test that confirmed it blocks out-of-scope actions.

text: How is human-in-the-loop confirmation enforced for high-impact agent actions?
intent: Verify Annex A.9.2 human oversight for agents.

followUps.text: What classes of action are blocked from full autonomy and require human confirmation? Show the policy.

text: Walk me through the multi-agent topology: which agents communicate with which, what protocols they use, and how isolation is enforced.
intent: Verify multi-agent isolation and communication controls.

followUps.text: How is privilege separation enforced between agents that share state, and what tests confirm one agent cannot escalate via another?

text: Show me the model card / data sheet for this predictive ML model, and confirm it covers performance, intended use, and limitations.
intent: Verify model documentation per Annex A.6.2.5/A.8.3.

followUps.text: Show me your own organisation's documented limitations and acceptance criteria for this specific deployment.

text: Walk me through bias and fairness assessment for this model: which subgroups, which metrics, what thresholds, what results.
intent: Verify Annex A.7.4 / A.5.4 bias controls.

followUps.text: Show me the per-subgroup performance breakdown and the action you took for any subgroup falling below threshold.

text: Walk me through reproducibility controls for the training pipeline: code, data, hyperparameters, and environment.

followUps.text: Show me the experiment-tracking record that pins data version, code commit, and environment for that checkpoint.

text: Walk me through how MCP server tool definitions are validated and how tool-poisoning is prevented.
intent: Verify MCP server tool-poisoning controls (probe P-MCP-01).

followUps.text: What signing and pinning controls verify upstream MCP tool definitions before they are exposed to the agent?

text: Show me the audit trail for tool invocations through the MCP server, including who, what, when, and outcome.

followUps.text: Show me a server-side audit log entry that captures the call independent of the agent process.

text: Walk me through access control on the vector database, especially for tenant or user-scoped retrieval.
commonDeflections: everyone with the key sees everything

followUps.text: How are tenant or sensitivity boundaries enforced at retrieval time?

text: How is embedding drift detected and handled for this vector store?

followUps.text: Show me the drift metric you monitor and the action triggered when it crosses the threshold.

text: Show me the most recent incident or near-miss involving this AI system and how it flowed through your incident-management process.
intent: Verify incident management for AI specifically.

followUps.text: Has any AI behaviour been flagged for investigation in monitoring? Show me the triage records.

text: How are AI-specific changes communicated through the management of change process, and what cross-functional approvals are mandatory?

followUps.text: Where are risk, legal, and AI-governance approvals captured for material AI changes?

text: Show me how this AI system's residual risks are reviewed and re-accepted on a defined cadence.

followUps.text: What is the policy-defined re-review cadence, and is the next review on the calendar?

text: How do you confirm objective evidence exists for each in-scope Annex A control declared applicable in the SoA?

followUps.text: Pick a control at random — show me the SoA entry, the implementation, and the evidence that ties them together.

text: Show me how you decommission an AI system, including data, model artefact, and dependency cleanup.

followUps.text: What about model artefacts, embeddings, and downstream dependencies — what is the documented cleanup checklist?
